query:
SELECT i.id AS "item_id!: ItemId",
                   ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT t COLLATE "C"
                           FROM UNNEST(i.required_tags) t
                          WHERE t <> ALL (b.probed_tags || b.declared_tags)
                          ORDER BY 1) AS "tags!"
              FROM item i CROSS JOIN box b
             WHERE i.id = ANY($1) AND b.id = $2
